title: Arrays
description:
## Arrays
Arrays store multiple values of the same type. In C#, you declare them with a fixed size:

```csharp
int[] scores = new int[3];
scores[0] = 10;
scores[1] = 20;
scores[2] = 30;
```

Or initialize directly:
```csharp
int[] scores = {10, 20, 30};
string[] names = {"Alice", "Bob", "Steve"};
```

Access by index (starts at 0):
```csharp
Console.WriteLine(scores[0]);    // 10
Console.WriteLine(names.Length);  // 3
```
